title: Peer Mentor Role Foundations
description: This module introduces the core principles of lived‑experience peer mentoring in the DFV context. It supports peer mentors to understand their role, use lived experience safely, and maintain clear scope and boundaries.
outcomes: Understand the purpose and responsibilities of the peer mentor role
Use lived experience safely, ethically, and without retraumatisation
Recognise the scope and limitations of peer support in DFV contexts
